items.title: John Budd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [transcript only]
items.q: my wife, the one I had for 45 years... I said, Irma, “You stay up too late.”

ctx.x: Well what were you doing staying out ‘till 3 in the morning? How could you do that?

Well I still have the habit of staying up late at night. We went last night and I thought we were the last people to leave the guy’s party. We were on the last bus. Everybody had gone, and I’ve had that all my life and my wife, the one I had for 45 years, she used to say that. “Why are we always the last one to go home?” I said, Irma, “You stay up too late.” “No it’s not.” And the wife I have now that is as fond of the music as I am, and we say the same thing. She says “why are we always the last ones to go…
Well someone’s got to be the last one.
